Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The plan clearly describes causal tracing methodology and ROME algorithm. Hyperparameters are documented in JSON files. No major guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: The environment uses standard dependencies (PyTorch, Transformers, NumPy). GPT-2 XL is publicly available from HuggingFace. Setup scripts are provided. No version conflicts encountered.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Random seeds are controlled (np.random.RandomState(1)). Causal tracing and ROME results are consistent across runs. Key findings (layer 17 peak, >99% efficacy) are reliably reproduced.
